text: When I told him quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> That I was the captain. <break time="0.8s" /> The swimmer, after a pause. <break time="0.8s" /> Gave his name as Leggatt. <break time="0.8s" /> And climbed aboard. <break time="0.8s" /> And I hurried below. <break time="0.8s" /> To fetch him a sleeping suit. <break time="0.8s" /> Dressed in grey stripes. <break time="0.8s" /> Exactly like my own. <break time="0.8s" /> He stood beside me in the dark. <break time="0.8s" /> And it seemed to me. <break time="0.8s" /> That I was looking at my double. <break time="0.8s" /> My second self. <break time="0.8s" /> Risen out of the sea. <break time="0.8s" /> He had been chief mate of the Sephora. <break time="0.8s" /> The ship anchored inside the islands. <break time="0.8s" /> And during a terrible gale. <break time="0.8s" /> He had quarrelled with an insolent sailor. <break time="0.8s" /> Who refused to obey his orders. <break time="0.8s" /> At the height of the storm. <break time="0.8s" /> He set a reefed foresail. <break time="0.8s" /> That saved the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet in the struggle. <break time="0.8s" /> A huge sea fell upon them. <break time="0.8s" /> And when the two men were found. <break time="0.8s" /> The sailor was dead. <break time="0.8s" /> Shut up in his cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> For weeks by his captain. <break time="0.8s" /> He expected to be handed over to the law at the first port. <break time="0.8s" /> And to be tried for the death. <break time="0.8s" /> On shore. <break time="0.8s" /> Finding his door unlocked one evening. <break time="0.8s" /> He had slipped into the sea. <break time="0.8s" /> And swum to the islands. <break time="0.8s" /> And from there. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing my riding light. <break time="0.8s" /> He had made for it. <break time="0.8s" /> Resolved never to go back. <break time="0.8s" /> Not for a moment did I think. <break time="0.8s" /> Of calling my officers. <break time="0.8s" /> For something in his calm, low voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Made me feel. <break time="0.8s" /> That his trouble might in other circumstances. <break time="0.8s" /> Have been mine. <break time="0.8s" /> So I led him to my stateroom. <break time="0.8s" /> An L shaped room. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose inner part could not be seen. <break time="0.8s" /> From the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And there, side by side. <break time="0.8s" /> We whispered in the dark.
